ttFields.title: Sub-Threshold DEP (TTFields-Style, Preview)
ttFields.caveatLead: PREVIEW and SIMULATOR CONSTRUCT: the mitotic exposure index is NOT from cited works.
ttFields.caveatBody: Models DEP coupling on cells in dish at sub-EP-threshold alternating fields (TTFields-style regime). Reframes published TTFields physics for in-vitro lab use. Does NOT predict clinical TTFields outcomes. Use only to compare sub-threshold protocols against each other on the bench.
ttFields.subThresholdOk: Sub-EP-threshold confirmed: Schwan membrane voltage is below the EP threshold for both populations.
ttFields.subThresholdWarn: ABOVE EP threshold. Lower the field or raise the frequency to stay in the sub-threshold DEP regime.
ttFields.reKTip: Re[K(ω)] Real part of the single-shell Clausius-Mossotti factor at the chosen frequency. Sets DEP force direction: positive → cell pulled toward |E|² maximum; negative → pushed away.
ttFields.forceTip: Time-averaged DEP force F = 2π·R³·ε_m·Re[K]·∇|E|², with ∇|E|² approximated as |E|²/L_grad (L_grad = 1 mm characteristic edge gradient — simulator construct).
ttFields.indexTip: Simulator construct, not from cited works. |F_DEP| × duration / (10 pN × 10 hr). A score ≥ 1 means the protocol delivers at least the reference dose; useful for ranking sub-threshold protocols on the bench, NOT for predicting any clinical or biological endpoint.
ttFields.hint: Higher Re[K] magnitude or longer duration raise the mitotic exposure index. Re[K] crosses zero at the DEP crossover frequency, which is also where directional sorting flips. Above ~300 kHz the Schwan rolloff drops the transmembrane potential further into the sub-threshold regime.
